text:
Tomasz Okonjo is this year's winner of the Calder Vane Prize for architecture, the jury announced on 14 March at the prize's annual ceremony.

I was in Veldmark Hall when Ilse Marchetti-Brandt, chair of the jury, stood to read the panel's published citation, "Statement of the 2025 Architecture Jury." She named Okonjo near the end of the statement, and the room responded with sustained applause.

The award carries a purse of 250,000 credits.

Marchetti-Brandt delivered the announcement from the lectern without notes beyond the citation itself. Okonjo was named as the sole recipient. Those seated near the front stood as the name was read, and the applause continued while the chair waited to finish the final lines of the statement.

The ceremony is held each year in the hall and is the prize's main public event.
